style: Say with bright, encouraging energy, like a friendly superhero coach
lines: Welcome to Loop Garden! Help the bunny plant flowers.
Garden 1: Hello, garden. Get the gardener to the seed spot and plant it. Tap blocks to build the program, then press Run.
Garden 2: A row of flowers. Six seeds in a row. You could use twelve blocks... or try a Repeat block.
Garden 3: Every other. Plant every other spot. What part keeps happening again and again?
Garden 4: Up the path. The gardener is facing the wrong way. Turn first, then repeat.
Garden 5: Four corners. Plant all four corners. Walk, plant, turn... and again.
Garden 6: Staircase. Climb the stairs and plant on every step.
Garden 7: Hop the rocks. Rocks are in the way! Find the way around one rock, then repeat it.
Free garden. No seed spots here. Plant flowers anywhere and make a picture: a line, a square, a letter?
Bonk! A rock is in the way.
Bonk! That's the edge of the garden.
Flowers planted! What picture did you make?
Add a Plant block to grow flowers.
One seed spot still needs planting. Change the program and run it again.
Some seed spots still need planting. Change the program and run it again.
Three stars!
Two stars!
One star!
All planted!
That's as short as we know how to make it!
Can you do it with 3 blocks?

Can you do it with 7 blocks?
